integrity: Complete proof and a deterministic finite diagnostic accompany the result; finite diagnostics are not proofs of infinite-dimensional claims.
scientific_limitations: Primitive-root and exact periodicity required; point-spectrum and dynamical claims use standard eigenvector theorems; shadowing step specializes an existing general result. Historical priority is provisional, with overlap risk from earlier cyclic weighted-operator results.
title: Cyclotomic collapse and the exact dynamical phase diagram of periodically weighted shifts
